text:
sara: Hey team, during a restore for customer-42 we hit AccessDenied from KMS when trying to decrypt snapshot-2026-03-18. Restore failed at 03:12 UTC.

mike: I saw that. Error in restore logs: `AccessDeniedException: kms:Decrypt denied for key arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd`

jen: Did we recently prune ephemeral grants? We merged that RBAC cleanup yesterday.

carol: We did expire short-lived grants after 7d as part of PR #2487. This snapshot is from 8 days ago.

encops-bot: incident-created:INC-2026-03-18-restore-403, severity:medium, assigned:encops.

sara: Ok looks like timebound grant expired before the snapshot lifecycle. Two threads: 1) immediate customer restore path 2) longer-term RBAC/grant policy change.

mike: For immediate triage can we reissue a one-off grant to the backup service account and retry? I can run `aws kms grant create --key-id ... --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::...:role/backup-uploader --operations Decrypt` with a limited grant-ttl.

jen: +1 but need audit trail. Make sure we tag grant with `created_by=restore-run` and log the grant ID to the incident.

carol: Also check CloudTrail: there may be a gap where grant creation events weren't indexed into our internal audit index for a 2-hour window last week. If that's true, we need to backfill.

mike: Doing the regrant now. Command output: ```
{
  "GrantId": "g-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h",
  "Status": "Active"
}
```

sara: Re-run restore?

mike: Restore retried, progressed past decrypt step. Completed at 03:28 UTC. Customer notified.

jen: Good. For the post-incident, root cause seems to be: snapshot TTL > ephemeral-grant-ttl after RBAC cleanup. We should enforce pre-checks at retention policy change time.

carol: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) reject RBAC rule changes that reduce grant TTL when snapshots older than TTL exist, 2) add a CI gating job that queries `list-snapshots` vs `grant-ttl` on PRs, 3) schedule a reindex of CloudTrail for the 2026-03-10..2026-03-18 window.

sara: Also need to update runbook: add a section "restore when grant expired" with steps: regrant, tag, retry, rotate grant and revoke after successful restore.

encops-bot: checklist-updated INC-2026-03-18-restore-403: added mitigation steps and assigned follow-ups to carol and jen.

mike: One vulnerability note: if we automate regrant on restore, ensure we do not allow privilege escalation — grants must be limited to `Decrypt` and tied to a single `GrantToken` and short TTL. Add automated approval if owner=oncall.

jen: I'll open PR for a policy check and the runbook changes. PR will include unit tests that simulate `grant-expiry` by mocking KMS responses.

carol: Ops action items:
- carol: run CloudTrail backfill job and report missing events by EOD
- jen: PR for gating + runbook by EOD+1
- mike: add regrant helper script to encops utilities and ensure it logs to audit index

sara: Customer-facing note drafted and sent. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT. :eyes:

mike: One last check — ensure S3 snapshots metadata has `cmek_key_id` and `snapshot_ts` so we can detect age vs TTL programmatically. If not, we need a migration job.

jen: I checked, older snapshots lacking explicit `cmek_key_id` exist from when we used account-default keys. Add migration plan to annotate metadata during next maintenance window.

carol: Logging note: we found an ingestion failure in the audit pipeline that dropped ~120 KMS events between 2026-03-10T01:00 and 2026-03-10T03:00 UTC. That's why the earlier grants weren't visible. Backfilling should recover them.

sara: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread and attach PR links and backfill report.

mike: attaching helper: `scripts/regrant_decrypt_for_restore.sh` (uploaded to encops repo)

jen: PR #2523 opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2523 — adds gating + runbook.

carol: CloudTrail backfill job completed, found 4 missing grant-create events. I've pushed them into the audit index and linked them to the incident.

sara: Closing incident when postmortem note is posted. Good work. :thumbsup:
